role_sought: Member of the Grand Council (Grosser Rat) of Basel-Stadt
detail: Elected to the cantonal parliament of Basel-Stadt; served 2001-2011, including on the Economics and Taxation Committee.

role_sought: Member of the National Council for Basel-Stadt
detail: Entered the National Council in 2010 succeeding the retiring SP colleague Rudolf (Ruedi) Rechsteiner.
Re-elected to the National Council in the 2011, 2015 and 2019 federal elections with strong results. He withdrew a Council of States candidacy in 2019 to make way for Eva Herzog.

role_sought: Member of the Government Council (Regierungsrat) of Basel-Stadt
detail: Elected to the Basel-Stadt cantonal government on 25 October 2020 and chosen as President of the Government (Regierungspraesident), serving 2021-2023.

role_sought: Member of the Federal Council (succeeding Alain Berset)
detail: The SP nominated Jans and Jon Pult as its official ticket. The United Federal Assembly elected Jans on the third ballot with 134 of 245 valid votes, ahead of party colleagues Pult and Jositsch. He took over the FDJP from Elisabeth Baume-Schneider.
